category: anonymous large-file upload page, Turkish market

free_tier.stated: Dosya yükle işlemini HızlıYükle ile kayıt olmadan yapın - Dosya başına 10GB'a kadar (upload without registering, up to 10 GB per file)
free_tier.notes: Found through a Turkish-language query; an English-language pass would not have surfaced it.

per_object_cap.stated: Dosya başına 10GB'a kadar (up to 10 GB per file)

retention.stated: unverified: the page publishes no expiry period

egress.terms: No byte allowance stated; the page advertises unlimited free upload with an optional password per file.

interface_detail: Browser drop zone with typed upload pages (image, video, PDF, large file). /api/upload and /upload answer 307 to another host, so the real endpoint is a redirect target that was not followed.
chaining: A Turkish-market 10 GB drop is the kind of regional option that survives when a Western service rate-limits a whole region; it needs its own measurement before it can be trusted.
limits_note: The 307 redirects on every path tried, including the API paths, which is either a canonical-host rule or a regional edge.
binding_note: 10 GB per file is the published ceiling and the only number available; retention is unstated so nothing else can be named.

identity_cost.detail: 'Hesap oluşturmanıza gerek yok' (no need to create an account), with an optional per-file password.

reliability_note: No published operator or retention; the redirect on every path means a client must pin the canonical host.
confidence_note: The cap and the no-account sentence are quoted from the vendor page in Turkish; no upload was attempted.

evidence.proved: 'Dosya başına 10GB'a kadar' and 'Hesap oluşturmanıza gerek yok' on the Turkish upload page
